page.layout: One column of running text, full width, with no marginal notes. Below the text: the gathering signature at the left and the catchword at the right. The ragged dark stripes on the right are scan edge and are not transcribed.

main_text.l: quam miscuerunt, cum ipsi ex Levitis,
populi verò, quos docent, ex gentibus o-
riginem deducant. Cacæ,Hierosolymis,
ac in urbe Sichem similiter Pauci erant,
ut Cairi, Damasci profecto aliquantulo
plures, at non multo. Ibi domus eorum
& Synagogas inspexi, quæ sunt extra civi-
tatem, inter hortos amænissimos; extrin-
secus quidem pauperum more, ob metum
Turcarum, qui divitiis admodū inhiant,
intus verò elegantes, præsertim ædes illis s-
acræ, picturis & auro decenter cohone-
statæ, pluribusque in locis inscriptioni-
bus Samaritano charactere insignitæ. Sed
de his hactenus. Quod ad libros Ægypti-
acos, plures hic habemus; in Bibliothe-
ca Vaticana nonnulli sunt: in Typogra-
phia Congregationis de fide propaganda
aliquot alii: apud me verò Psalterium,
Evangelium Joannis, & quædam alia ex
Evangeliis omnibus, ex Epistolis Cano-
nicis, & præsertim Epistola Jacobi,
quæ, ni fallor, ab Hæreticis recentioribus im-
pugnatur: & nescio, quæ alia Ecclesiastici
usus, omnia Arabice, optima atque anti-

page.notes: The gathering signature "1 5" at the foot is uncertain: the first mark could be "1" or "I", so it is marked [?]. The text was printed with long s, which is transcribed as s. The v/u and i/j spelling has been normalised (qvam to quam, qvos to quos, ut, verò kept with its accent as printed). The printed hyphens at the line ends (o-, extrin-, cohone-, anti-) are kept. The page continues on the next page at "qva", which is the catchword.
